title: Content builds wait out a flaky texture-tool download
items: The pinned KTX-Software 4.3.2 package that compresses every texture is now kept in the build cache, checked against its pinned fingerprint, and fetched with patient retries, so a passing gateway timeout from github.com no longer throws away a whole content build. On 8 November three builds in a row were lost that way with nothing wrong in the change; the fallback fetch inside tools/ktx2_sheets.py now retries too, and a self-test in the gate proves it waits out a 504 but refuses a missing file or a wrong fingerprint at once.
